subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` and the generic synchronous `onTaskTimeout` fence hook as the supported recovery contract for deferred context-engine maintenance?
rationale: New configuration, plugin lifecycle behavior, and timeout/fallback semantics are compatibility-sensitive product choices that cannot be approved from patch correctness and proof alone.

options.title: Approve dedicated opt-in contract
options.body: Accept the disabled-by-default maintenance setting and late-side-effect fence as the supported operator recovery path.

options.title: Choose a finite default
options.body: Enable automatic recovery for existing users while explicitly accepting that legitimately long maintenance may be timed out during upgrades.

options.title: Reuse another lifecycle contract
options.body: Avoid the new setting or hook by binding maintenance to an owner-approved existing timeout or cooperative cancellation API.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept the disabled-by-default maintenance setting and late-side-effect fence as the supported operator recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman introduced the context-engine lifecycle, merged background maintenance, and maintained its runtime-context contract.
